newsitem.title: USA: Wang Laboratories says gets FAA contract.
newsitem.headline: Wang Laboratories says gets FAA contract.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said on Monday that its subsidiary Wang Government Services had been chosen as a subcontractor to provide integration of enterprise management for the Federal Aviation Administration.

Wang Laboratories declined to disclose how much the contract was worth, but said a unit of Hughes Aircraft Co, Hughes Information Technology Systems, was the primary contractor in the deal, known as the indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract.
The contract covers three base years plus two additional two-year options, Wang Laboratories said.

"As the lead subcontractor for network enterprise management integration, Wang will integrate commercial-off-the-shelf software used in the system, will participate in the systems engineering and systems development, and will lead operations and maintenance of the program," the company said.
Wang is a network and desktop services and integration company.
